verdict.rationale: WezTerm ships an embedded mux server that users can run themselves (self-hosted) and connect to via SSH domains, with docs on multiplexing and SSH domains plus a runtime probe confirming a fully headless `wezterm-mux-server --daemonize` control loop with `wezterm cli` spawn/send-text/get-text/list working without a GUI session. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of self-hosted mux server usage specifically (most community quotes discuss desktop terminal use, not self-hosted server operation), and explicit licensing/deployment guidance for running it as a persistent self-hosted service.
